{{Quote|This bank has been robbed so many times, we've given up protecting it. Although we don't admit that.|GTA San Andreas Website.}}

The '''Palomino Creek Bank''' is a bank that appears in {{SA}}. As its name implies, the bank is located in [[Palomino Creek]], [[Red County (3D Universe)|Red County]], [[State of San Andreas (3D Universe)|San Andreas]].

==Description==
The bank is a simple building with a bank sign in front of the building, with the [[Palomino Creek Diner]] located behind the bank. The interior of the bank can be accessed at any point before [[Small Town Bank]]. Once the mission is passed, both the front and the rear entrances get barred, no longer allowing access. The interior is always empty, except for its mission appearance. Behind the building, there is a staircase to the rooftop.

==Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''==
In the mission [[Small Town Bank]], [[Catalina]] and [[Carl Johnson]] rob the bank and steal [[money]] from its [[Automated Teller Machine|ATMs]], presumably $20,000 (if the two split the money evenly; CJ alone gets $10,000 as a reward).
